appName: Game Box - Your Ultimate Game Hub
displayName: Game Box - Your Ultimate Game Hub
display_name: Game Box - Your Ultimate Game Hub
display_long_description:
Welcome to Game Box, your all-in-one gaming hub packed with hundreds of fun and addictive games across a wide range of categories. Whether you're into action, puzzles, racing, arcade, strategy, or casual games, Game Box has something for everyone.

No need to download multiple apps—Game Box gives you instant access to a massive collection of games in one place. Discover new favorites, challenge your skills, and enjoy endless entertainment wherever you are.

Key Features:

🎮 Hundreds of Games – Explore a huge variety of games across multiple genres

⚡ Instant Play – Jump into games quickly without long downloads

🧠 Multiple Categories – Action, Puzzle, Racing, Arcade, Strategy & more

🌍 Play Anytime, Anywhere – Enjoy games on the go

🔄 Regular Updates – New games added frequently to keep things fresh

Whether you have a few minutes or hours to spare, Game Box is your perfect companion for non-stop gaming fun.
